notablePrerequisites:
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
"Treefolk" chosen with Xenograft.
description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability by paying {4}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When the Eldrazi Spawns enter the battlefield as Treefolk due to Xenograft, Quickbeam triggers twice, giving Devoted Druid and up to one other creature +4/+4 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
